caption: The drawing depicts a single glass inkwell centered on a plain, off-white background. The inkwell is rendered in shades of light green and blue, with touches of white and darker green to indicate reflections and transparency suggestive of glass. The object has a wide, circular base that flares outward, a narrower neck, and a small, round cap or stopper on top. The shading and highlights provide a sense of depth and curvature to the glass surface. There are no other objects, markings, or decorations present in the composition, and the inkwell is positioned in the middle of the otherwise empty page.
title: Inkwell
